IT TOOK 7 YEARS TO CREATE AND
4.7 SECONDS
TO UNDERSTAND WHY
REAR-WHEEL DRIVE (RWD)
OR ALL-WHEEL DRIVE (AWD)*
are both tuned to give you maximum
driving thrills with either choice
ISO-STRUCTURETM
is made with 55% advanced, high-strength steel to help
improve rigidity in a variety of circumstances — which
means you’ll enjoy better driving dynamics and a quiet ride
FIVE DRIVE MODE SELECTIONS
adjust steering boost, shift points, throttle mapping, and
suspension damping* to give you a choice of five unique
drive modes: Smart, ECO, Comfort, Sport, or Custom
LAUNCH CONTROL SYSTEM*
maximizes off-the-line response for quick acceleration^
ELECTRONICALLY CONTROLLED SUSPENSION (ECS)*
is designed to give you the ride you want, from comfort to sport,
by adapting the suspension of the car to the driving conditions
MECHANICAL LIMITED-SLIP DIFFERENTIAL*
helps to evenly distribute power through the rear
wheels, resulting in more responsive and agile handling^
SPORT VARIABLE GEAR RATIO STEERING*
increases steering responsiveness during spirited
driving to elevate your driving experience^

Stinger’s 365-horsepower,§ 3.3L V6* has a 0–60 time of 4.7 seconds and a top
speed of 167 mph.† It’s faster than the 2018 Audi A7 Sportback AWD, 2019
BMW 640i Gran Coupe, and 2018 Porsche Panamera V6 RWD.‡ And everything,
from its wheel housings to kicked-up trunk lid, has been ingeniously
engineered to cheat the wind for incredible stability at higher speeds. But it’s
also made for the long journey. So you can take your time, just like we did.
*Optional feature available only on certain trims. See kia.com for details. §With premium gasoline. †Preliminary performance
estimates determined by Kia for Stinger GT rear-wheel drive using Launch Control and factory-equipped with 19-inch
wheels. Stinger GTs that are factory-equipped with 18-inch wheels are limited to 130 mph top speed (i.e., installation of
19-inch wheels will not increase the top speed). Actual results may vary depending on options, driving conditions, driving
habits, and vehicle condition. Verification of these results should not be attempted. Always drive safely and obey all traffic
laws. ‡Based on published manufacturer specifications as of June 2018. ^Always drive safely and use caution. GT2 SHOWN

BRAKES THAT WERE BORN
ON THE TRACK
Look behind the GT’s 19-inch wheels* and you’ll find
vented Brembo® brakes — the same brand found on some
of the most prestigious cars of the last 40 years. They
help give you outstanding deceleration performance and
precise handling in a variety of conditions.†
BREMBO® HIGH-PERFORMANCE BRAKES*
GT’s powerful Brembo® brakes feature signature red, fixed
quad-piston front calipers and dual-piston rear calipers.
Larger overall brake rotors than the 2018 Porsche Panamera
V6‡ help provide more consistent braking performance†
BRAKE ASSIST SYSTEM (BAS)
If you suddenly slam on your brakes, BAS is designed to sense the urgency
and apply full braking power, which can help shorten your braking distance†
ELECTRONIC BRAKE-FORCE DISTRIBUTION (EBD)
Based on the vehicle’s weight distribution, it helps adjust the balance
of braking power accordingly†
BRAKE FADE COMPENSATION
It automatically increases hydraulic pressure in the braking system as
the temperatures rise, so the driver does not need to press as hard on
the pedal. This results in a more consistent and confident braking feel†
*Optional feature available only on certain trims. See kia.com for details. †No system, no matter
how advanced, can compensate for all driver errors, driving conditions, accidents, and/or injury.
Always drive safely. ‡Based on published manufacturer specifications as of June 2018. GT2 SHOWN

adds premium luxury to the deeply contoured seats
HEATED & VENTILATED SEATS*
include standard heated front seats, optional heated rear outboard
seats, and optional ventilated front seats
1 6-WAY POWER-ADJUSTABLE DRIVER’S SEAT*
includes width-adjusting power side bolsters and 4-way aircell lumbar
support for optimal comfort
INTEGRATED MEMORY SYSTEM*
remembers the setting preferences for two drivers including seat
position, steering wheel, and outside mirrors
SPACIOUS INTERIOR
comes courtesy of Stinger’s generous wheelbase, which is longer
than the 2019 BMW 4-Series Gran Coupe and 2018 Audi A5 Sportback† —
giving Stinger a very spacious interior
